parties.petitioner: Tamil Nadu And Puducherry Paper Cup Manufacturers Association

summary: Environmental ban on single-use plastics challenged; standard of judicial review in policy decisions; scope of mandatory consultation procedure under Environment Protection Rules 1986; classification of LDPE-coated paper cups as 'plastics'; recyclability and biodegradability issues; deference to expert opinion; Article 14 and Article 19(1)(g) challenges; ban upheld as reasonable environmental measure; no violation of mandatory procedural norms.
legal_provisions_cited: Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board v. M.V. Nayudu
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; uphold High Court judgment validating Government Order banning single-use plastics including paper cups with LDPE coating and non-woven plastic bags; ban found within state's environmental regulatory competence.
